examples.en: It took me a while to figure out why the tests only failed on Fridays.
examples.zh: 我花了好一阵才弄明白，为什么测试只在周五挂。

situation.en: I finally figured out what was causing it — a timezone bug.
situation.zh: 同事问你那个诡异的 bug 查得怎么样了，你想说刚弄明白。

entries.zh: 想明白、弄清楚（自己琢磨出来的）

examples.en: She came up with a workaround that bought us two extra weeks.
examples.zh: 她想出了一个临时方案，给我们多争取了两周。

situation.en: Let me come up with a couple of options and share them tomorrow.
situation.zh: 会上卡住了，你想说自己有个想法。

entries.zh: 想出（方案、主意）

examples.en: I need a day to sort out this billing mess before we add new features.
examples.zh: 我需要一天把计费这团乱账理顺，再加新功能。

situation.en: I'll sort out the permission issues today.
situation.zh: 站会上你想说今天先处理权限那堆遗留问题。

entries.zh: 理顺、解决（乱成一团的问题）

examples.en: We narrowed it down to two possible causes by turning features off one by one.
examples.zh: 我们逐个关掉功能，把可能性缩小到了两个。

situation.en: First I narrowed it down to the cache layer, then checked the logs.
situation.zh: 面试官问你怎么定位的，你想说先把范围缩小。

entries.zh: 缩小范围（把候选一个个排除）

examples.en: We ran into a problem with the payment provider's sandbox — it behaves nothing like production.
examples.zh: 我们撞上了支付服务商的沙箱环境问题，它和生产环境完全不一样。

entries.note: run into 也可以是偶遇某人：I ran into an old colleague at the airport。

situation.en: We ran into a problem with the certificates, so the release slipped a day.
situation.zh: 站会上汇报进展，你想说遇到了点麻烦。

entries.zh: 撞上、遇到（问题或麻烦）

examples.en: The job ran out of disk space halfway through the export.
examples.zh: 导出跑到一半，磁盘空间用完了。

situation.en: We're running out of budget for cloud spend this quarter.
situation.zh: 会上你想提醒大家：预算快没了。

entries.zh: 用完、耗尽（时间、钱、空间）

examples.en: Let me break down the estimate so you can see where the time goes.
examples.zh: 我把工时估算拆开讲，你就知道时间都花在哪了。

entries.note: break down 讲故障（The car broke down）和讲分解（break down the numbers）是同一个词，靠宾语区分。

situation.en: Let me break it down into three parts: ingestion, processing, and serving.
situation.zh: 面试官让你细说一个复杂项目，你想先拆成几块讲。

entries.zh: （机器、谈判）出故障、破裂；分解（把大问题拆开讲）

examples.en: If the new API is not ready, we can fall back on the old import path.
examples.zh: 如果新接口还没好，我们可以退回到旧的导入方式兜底。

situation.en: We still have the legacy flow to fall back on.
situation.zh: 评审时有人问新方案失败了怎么办，你想说有老方案兜底。

entries.zh: 退而求其次、靠（备选方案）兜底

examples.en: We keep putting off the upgrade, and the version gap keeps growing.
examples.zh: 我们一直推迟升级，版本差距越拉越大。

entries.note: put someone off 是“让某人反感”，意思不同，别混。

situation.en: Can we put off the review until tomorrow? I need another hour.
situation.zh: 你想跟同事商量把评审推迟到明天。

entries.zh: 推迟、拖延（本来该做的事）

examples.en: I finally got around to updating the onboarding doc after three months.
examples.zh: 拖了三个月，我终于抽时间把入职文档更新了。

situation.en: Sorry, I haven't got around to it yet — it's on my list for Friday.
situation.zh: 同事问你那个文档写了没，你想说一直没顾上。

entries.zh: 终于抽出时间去做（拖了很久的事）

examples.en: Let's hold off on the announcement until the hotfix is verified.
examples.zh: 我们先别发公告，等热修复验证通过再说。

situation.en: I'd hold off on the experiment until we have better metrics.
situation.zh: 你想建议团队暂缓上这个实验功能。

entries.zh: 先别做、暂缓（等条件成熟）

examples.en: Monday mornings I catch up on everything that happened while I was on leave.
examples.zh: 周一早上我会把休假期间落下的事情都补看一遍。

situation.en: Give me an hour to catch up on messages, then let's sync.
situation.zh: 休假回来第一天，你想跟同事说先补一下进度。

entries.zh: 把落下的……补上（工作、消息、睡眠）

examples.en: It is hard to keep up with how fast the frontend ecosystem changes.
examples.zh: 前端生态变化太快，很难跟上。

situation.en: I keep up with new releases by reading the changelogs every week.
situation.zh: 面试聊到学习习惯，你想说你能跟上新技术。

entries.zh: 跟上（变化、进度、潮流）

examples.en: She likes to bring up the flaky tests in every retro, and she is right — it is time to fix them.
examples.zh: 她每次复盘都爱提不稳定的测试问题，她说得对，是该修了。

situation.en: I wanted to bring up the on-call load — it has doubled since June.
situation.zh: 一对一时你想提一下加班太多的事。

entries.zh: 提出、提起（话题、问题）

examples.en: The reviewer pointed out that my query would do a full table scan.
examples.zh: 评审的人指出，我的查询会全表扫描。

situation.en: I'd like to point out one risk: this cache has no invalidation strategy.
situation.zh: 评审里你想礼貌地指出对方方案的一个风险。

entries.zh: 指出（某个事实或问题）

examples.en: I will follow up with the vendor if they do not reply by Thursday.
examples.zh: 如果供应商周四之前不回复，我会再跟进一次。

entries.note: 名词是 follow-up：a quick follow-up question。口语里两个都常见。

situation.en: I'll follow up on the pricing question and post in the channel.
situation.zh: 会后你想跟同事确认你来跟进这件事。

entries.zh: 跟进（之前的事有没有下文）

examples.en: I do not have the numbers yet — let me get back to you by end of day.
examples.zh: 我现在还没有数据，今天下班前答复你。

situation.en: Let me double-check and get back to you on that.
situation.zh: 面试官问了个细节你记不清，你想说回头确认。

entries.zh: 回头答复（某人）

examples.en: Before I refactor it, I want to run the plan by our tech lead.
examples.zh: 动手重构之前，我想先把方案说给技术负责人听听。

situation.en: Can I run something by you? I'm thinking of changing how we do releases.
situation.zh: 你有了个主意，想先说给同事把把关。

entries.zh: 把（想法）说给（某人）听、征求意见

examples.en: We need to carry out the migration in a single weekend.
examples.zh: 我们需要在一个周末内把这次迁移执行完。

situation.zh: 面试介绍项目时，你想说计划是你负责落地的。
situation.en: My job was to carry out the rollout plan with two other engineers.

entries.zh: 执行、实施（计划、任务）

examples.en: It took me half a day to set up the dev environment on the new laptop.
examples.zh: 在新电脑上搭开发环境花了我半天。

situation.en: Ping me if you get stuck setting up your environment.
situation.zh: 新同事入职，你想帮他把环境弄好。

entries.zh: 搭好、设置（环境、账号、会议）

examples.en: When our tech lead left, I took over the release process.
examples.zh: 技术负责人走了之后，我接手了发布流程。

situation.en: I can take over your on-call while you are away.
situation.zh: 同事要休假，你主动说他的值班你来接。

entries.zh: 接手（工作、项目）

examples.en: Users reported slow uploads — I will look into it this afternoon.
examples.zh: 有用户反馈上传慢，我下午调查一下。

situation.en: Thanks for flagging it, I'll look into it and update the ticket.
situation.zh: 有人报了个问题你还不清楚，你答应去看。

entries.zh: 调查、了解一下（还没结论）

examples.en: Let's go over the design doc together before the review meeting.
examples.zh: 评审会之前，我们先一起把设计文档过一遍。

situation.en: Could you go over my résumé once more before I send it?
situation.zh: 你想请同事帮你把简历再看一遍。

entries.zh: 仔细过一遍（文档、方案）

examples.en: We went through the whole checklist before the audit and found two gaps.
examples.zh: 审计前我们把清单逐条过了一遍，发现了两个缺口。

situation.en: We went through a rough night, but the rollback saved us.
situation.zh: 面试讲故障经历时，你想说那晚很折腾。

entries.zh: 经历（一段麻烦过程）；逐条审阅

examples.en: The proposal is just an outline — I need to flesh out the details this week.
examples.zh: 这个方案还只是个提纲，我这周要把细节充实起来。

entries.note: flesh 是肉：给骨架长肉，就是细化。别写成 flush out，那是“冲出来/赶出来”。

situation.en: Good direction — let's flesh out the error handling part.
situation.zh: 评审时你评价同事的草案还不错，就是需要细化。

entries.zh: 把（想法、方案）充实、细化

examples.en: The doc spells out exactly who owns each step of the incident process.
examples.zh: 文档把故障流程每一步归谁负责都写得清清楚楚。

situation.en: Let me spell it out: we ship Friday, or we cut the feature.
situation.zh: 同事没听懂你的意思，你主动说得更直白一点。

entries.zh: 把话说明白、一条条讲清楚

examples.en: If we stick to the plan, the beta ships on the fifteenth.
examples.zh: 只要坚持原计划，测试版就能在 15 号发。

situation.en: Let's stick to the plan and park the new ideas for v2.
situation.zh: 范围开始膨胀，你想提醒大家守住原计划。

entries.zh: 坚持（计划、约定）不改

examples.en: The discussion was going in circles, so our manager stepped in and made the call.
examples.zh: 讨论一直在绕圈子，经理出手拍了板。

situation.en: I can step in on the incident while you take a break.
situation.zh: 同事卡在故障上，你说你来顶一下。

entries.zh: 出手介入（出问题时顶上）

examples.en: Feel free to jump in with questions at any point.
examples.zh: 任何时候有问题都可以直接插进来问。

situation.en: Mind if I jump in on this? I worked on something similar last year.
situation.zh: 你想加入隔壁组的一个项目。

entries.zh: 插话、加入（讨论或项目），语气积极

examples.en: I decided to take on the documentation work because nobody else had time.
examples.zh: 别人都没时间，我决定把文档工作接下来。

situation.en: I can take it on, but something else has to give.
situation.zh: 经理问你能不能再多带一个项目，你掂量后答应。

entries.zh: 承担、接下（额外的工作）

examples.en: Before my leave, I handed over the release checklist and the pending tickets.
examples.zh: 休假之前，我把发布清单和未处理的工单都交接了。

entries.note: 名词 handover（交接）英式拼写常见，美式常写 hand-off。

situation.en: Let's do a proper hand-over call on Thursday.
situation.zh: 你想跟接班的同事约个交接时间。

entries.zh: 交接（把工作交出去）

examples.en: Back up the database before you run any migration, no exceptions.
examples.zh: 跑任何迁移之前先备份数据库，没有例外。

situation.en: I'll back you up in the review — the data supports the proposal.
situation.zh: 同事的方案被质疑，你站出来支持他。

entries.zh: 备份；支持、给（某人）撑腰

examples.en: I check in with my mentor every two weeks, even when nothing is urgent.
examples.zh: 就算没什么急事，我每两周也会和导师碰一下。

situation.en: Let me check in with you after standup about the timeline.
situation.zh: 你想约同事下午简单确认下进度。

entries.zh: 跟（某人）碰一下、确认近况

examples.en: I missed out on the early-bird tickets because I waited a day too long.
examples.zh: 我多等了一天，错过了早鸟票。

situation.en: You don't want to miss out on this one — last year's was excellent.
situation.zh: 同事犹豫要不要报名内部分享，你劝他别错过。

entries.zh: 错过（机会、活动）

examples.en: After three months of on-call every other week, he burned out and quit.
examples.zh: 隔周值班熬了三个月，他累垮了，辞了职。

entries.note: 名词是 burnout（一个词）：signs of burnout。形容词 burned out 或 burnt out。

situation.en: If we keep this pace, people will burn out by spring.
situation.zh: 一对一时你想提醒经理团队的负荷不健康。

entries.zh: 累垮、职业倦怠
偶然发现、碰到（信息或东西）

examples.en: I came across an old design doc that explains why we built it this way.
examples.zh: 我偶然翻到一份旧的设计文档，里面讲了当初为什么这么做。

situation.zh: 你在调研时意外找到一篇正好相关的文章，想跟同事说。
situation.en: I came across a post that covers exactly this problem.

entries.zh: 结果发现是、最后证明是

examples.en: The outage turned out to be a bad config, not a code bug.
examples.zh: 查到最后，这次故障是配置错误，不是代码 bug。

situation.zh: 你向同事转述调查结论：其实原因很简单。
situation.en: It turned out to be a typo in the config file.

entries.zh: 期待（后面接名词或动名词）

examples.en: I am looking forward to working with the new design team.
examples.zh: 我很期待和新的设计团队合作。

situation.zh: 面试最后，你想得体地表达期待加入。
situation.en: I really look forward to hearing from you.

entries.note: to 是介词，后面接名词或 -ing：look forward to seeing you。别写成 look forward to see。

entries.zh: 跟（某人）相处得来

examples.en: He gets along with everyone on the team, including the tricky stakeholders.
examples.zh: 他和团队里每个人都处得来，包括难搞的干系人。

situation.zh: 面试官问你和上一任经理的关系，你想说处得不错。
situation.en: I got along well with my previous manager.

entries.zh: 放手去做吧；请便（表示许可或开始）

examples.en: The reviewer said go ahead and merge it once CI passes.
examples.zh: 评审的人说 CI 一过就直接合并吧。

situation.zh: 同事问能不能先用你的会议室，你想说尽管用。
situation.en: Sure, go ahead — I am not using it this hour.
